name: skinote
description: 스키노트 · 스키 렌탈샵 운영 시스템(포스 · 차량 · 관리)

scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:schema && npm run test:unit
scripts.lint: npm run lint:schema && npm run check:imports
scripts.lint:schema: npm run lint -w @skinote/schema -- --code src tools bin && npm run split -w @skinote/schema -- --check && npm run gen-triggers -w @skinote/schema -- --check
scripts.rules: npm run build && npm run test:rules
scripts.check: npm test && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run check:dist && npm run test:pwa && npm run test:rules
